notes.purpose: Combo-specific articles for Paranoid Times newspaper when multiple cards synergize in a single turn.
notes.integration: Match by card IDs or by tags. Highest priority match wins. Exclusive combos suppress lower-priority ones.
notes.how_to_use: Load after per-card article bank. For each turn, build a turn signature from played cards (IDs, factions, tags). Evaluate combos by priority, emit up to N articles.

defaults.imageStyle: grainy 1990s black and white photo, halftone newspaper style, slightly out of focus

combos.headline: BAT BOY & BIGFOOT HOLD SECRET SUMMIT — ‘HAIR-TO-HAIR’ TALKS STUN NATION!
combos.subhead: Witnesses report firm handshake, questionable grooming tips.
body: In a moonlit clearing, representatives from the Bat Boy bloc and the Bigfoot diaspora agreed to a cease‑screech.
Sources close to the saplings claim the agenda included forest corridor treaties, photo consent, and joint statements on blurry imagery.
Analysts say tonight’s détente will echo across county fairs and campground Wi‑Fi for weeks.
combos.imagePrompt: {style}, forest press scrum, Bigfoot and Bat Boy at makeshift podium, disposable camera flash, deadpan crowd

combos.headline: ELVIS PILOTS SAUCER TO 3 A.M. DINER — JUMPSUIT DOCKING ‘PERFECT’
combos.subhead: Area 51 traffic control denies ever hearing ‘Thank you, control tower, very much.’
body: A late‑night fly‑in rattled the aluminum napkin dispensers as a silver disc parallel‑parked between two pickup trucks.
Witnesses describe a velvet‑accented autopilot and a setlist synced to the neon flicker of roadside signage.
Officials insist it was ‘weather refraction’ and urge onlookers to ignore the sequined flight manual.
combos.imagePrompt: {style}, diner parking lot, classic UFO gently landing, rhinestone jumpsuit reflection in chrome, flash glare

combos.headline: FOIA BLITZ SHREDS REDACTIONS — BLACK BARS PANIC, INK FLEES MARGINS
combos.subhead: Clerks report ‘stamp fatigue’ as disclosure avalanche buries conference room C.
body: A cascade of requests detonated beneath a decades‑old memo dam, launching staplers into low orbit.
Redaction rectangles attempted to organize a sit‑in but were mistaken for modernist art and donated to a lobby.
Experts warn more paragraphs may come forward once they learn the word for ‘paragraph’.
combos.imagePrompt: {style}, file room snowed in by paper, black bars sliding off pages, frantic clerks, flash overexposure

combos.headline: MEN IN CHARCOAL ‘CORDIALLY MISPLACE’ WITNESSES — PARADE ROUTE DETOURS INTO BASEMENT
combos.subhead: City map now lists stairs as ‘scenic tunnel.’
body: A well‑organized witness parade was gently re‑filed behind a locked door labeled ‘empathy training.’
Participants emerged with clipboards, matching ties, and a new appreciation for indoor sunglasses.
Observers praised the efficiency, though some wondered why the confetti looked like shredded affidavits.
combos.imagePrompt: {style}, municipal basement hallway, polite agents with clipboards, parade float wedged in doorway, flash glare

combos.headline: HAUNTED WALMART HOSTS MIDNIGHT SUMMIT — CARTS FORM PENTAGRAM IN AISLE 7
combos.subhead: Rollback on ectoplasm; clean‑up over PA system never ends.
body: Security footage shows shopping carts arranging themselves into confidential patterns between seasonal displays.
Ghost hunters, coupon clippers, and one very confident grandma negotiated a cease‑boo around the freezer aisle.
Corporate denies paranormal activity but confirms a ‘spectral shrinkage’ line item.
combos.imagePrompt: {style}, fluorescent big‑box aisle, spectral carts in formation, blurred ghost hunters, harsh flash

combos.headline: MOTHMAN ISSUES PUBLIC WARNING — BRIDGE LIGHTS BLINK ‘DUCK’ IN MORSE
body: Local infrastructure developed a conscience as sodium lamps spelled cautionary verbs across the steelwork.
Commuters claimed their dashboards whispered coordinates, though GPS insisted it was ‘road work.’
Engineers recommend heeding winged advisories until further notice.
combos.imagePrompt: {style}, night bridge, winged silhouette near lamps, blinking lights captured by dashcam, grainy flash

combos.headline: DENVER AIRPORT BUNKER HOSTS ‘ART TOUR’ — PRESS POOL LOSES ENTRANCE TWICE
body: Reporters were escorted through a tasteful maze featuring tasteful doors that opened into tasteful identical rooms.
Public‑address system played ambient confidence while badges changed color every seven minutes.
Attendees left with souvenir blindfolds and a renewed appreciation for escalators to nowhere.
combos.imagePrompt: {style}, cavernous airport tunnel, press lanyards, murals with conspiratorial motifs, harsh security flash

combos.headline: PASTOR REX REVIVAL GOES MEGAPHONIC — TENT PEWS VIBRATE WITH ‘DISCLOSURE’
body: A canvas cathedral roared as portable amps translated prophecy into RSS feeds.
Vendors sold glow‑in‑the‑dark hymnals marked ‘beta’ while ushers calibrated the truth meter between songs.
Skeptics left clutching bumper stickers that read ‘I brake for revelations.’
combos.imagePrompt: {style}, revival tent at night, portable speakers, ecstatic crowd, handheld flash

combos.headline: FLORIDA MAN DECLARES ‘OPEN SEASON ON SECRETS’ — GATOR WAVES TINY FLAG
body: A roadside attraction doubled as an impromptu press conference when a man in reflective swimwear unveiled a hand‑drawn conspiracy flowchart.
Spectators reported sudden humidity spikes whenever he said the word ‘cover‑up.’
Tourism officials are split on whether this counts as a festival.
combos.imagePrompt: {style}, swamp roadside mic stand, alligator with tiny flag, disposable camera glare

combos.headline: GHOSTLY INTERVENTION INTERRUPTS RAID — EVIDENCE FLOATS ITSELF TO FRONT PAGE
body: Half the team filmed, the other half levitated.
Case files developed an afterlife, flipping to the incriminating paragraphs without human help.
A haunted hole punch awarded three extra binders to whoever said ‘please.’
combos.imagePrompt: {style}, evidence room with floating files, team reacting, stark flash, swirling dust

combos.headline: PRESS LOCKDOWN BACKFIRES — EXPOSÉ PRINTS ITSELF THROUGH SEALED DOOR
combos.subhead: Printer denies involvement, cites ‘free press clause.’
body: A cordoned‑off press pool encountered an uncooperative laser printer that chose violence via duplex.
Security attempted to confiscate the paper, but it filed a restraining order in triplicate.
Witnesses swear the toner smelled like accountability.
combos.imagePrompt: {style}, locked briefing room, printer spitting pages under door, burst flash

combos.headline: STATE GOES STRANGE — BONUS CASCADES INTO TONIGHT’S EDITION
body: Local anomalies synchronized with the card plays, producing charts, graphs, and at least one haunted pie chart.
Experts caution that the effect will wear off when the map stops humming.
Residents demand a commemorative sticker.
combos.imagePrompt: {style}, US state outline overlay, glitchy weather radar, flash artifacts
